name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal instalments of ₹2,000 to landholding farmer families.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land
Excluded: institutional landholders, income tax payers, government employees
benefits: ₹6,000/year (₹2,000 every 4 months) directly to Aadhaar-linked bank account
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) – Crop Insurance
description: Comprehensive crop insurance against natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest at ultra-low premium rates (1.5-5%).
eligibility: All farmers (loanee and non-loanee, tenant farmers, sharecroppers) growing notified crops in notified areas
benefits: Full sum insured payout for crop loss due to drought, flood, inundation, pests, diseases, cyclone, hailstorm. Premium: Kharif 2%, Rabi 1.5%, Commercial/Horticulture 5%.
documents: Sowing certificate issued by Patwari/Gram Sevak
how_to_apply: Apply at bank branch, CSC, or online at pmfby.gov.in before cutoff date (Kharif: July 31, Rabi: Dec 31)

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Timely credit for farmers to meet short-term cultivation expenses, post-harvest costs, and working capital for animal husbandry & fisheries.
eligibility: Individual farmers, joint borrowers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, SHGs/JLGs of farmers, animal husbandry & fishery farmers
benefits: Credit limit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% effective interest rate (with 3% prompt repayment subvention). No collateral for loans up to ₹1.6 lakh.
how_to_apply: Apply at any commercial bank, RRB, or Cooperative Bank branch or pmkisan.gov.in (KCC section)

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Pumps and Grid-Connected Solar Power)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
description: Subsidized standalone solar agriculture pumps (Component B) and solarisation of existing grid-connected pumps (Component C) to ensure day-time reliable power for irrigation.
eligibility: Farmers, Panchayats, Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs), Water User Associations
benefits: Up to 60% total subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) on standalone solar pumps up to 7.5 HP. Farmer pays only 10-40% of cost.
how_to_apply: Apply through state nodal renewable energy agency (e.g. MEDA, HAREDA, REDA) or pmkusum.mnre.gov.in

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides customized soil nutrient status cards every 2 years with crop-specific fertilizer and soil amendment recommendations.
eligibility: All farmers across India possessing agricultural land
benefits: Free soil testing for 12 parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) + exact dosage advice to cut fertilizer costs by 20-25%.
how_to_apply: Contact local Agricultural Extension Officer, Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), or visit soilhealth.dac.gov.in

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) – Organic Farming
description: Promotes chemical-free organic farming through cluster approach with Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) organic certification.
eligibility: Farmers forming clusters of 20 or more farmers having total 50 acres (20 ha) land
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years (₹31,000/ha directly for organic inputs like bio-fertilizers, neem cake, vermicompost).
how_to_apply: Form a local farmer group and contact District Agriculture Officer or visit pgsprod-dac.gov.in

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
description: Subsidies for buying farm machinery (tractors, rotavators, power tillers, harvesters) and establishing Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers, SC/ST, women farmers, FPOs, registered farmer groups
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy on individual machinery. Up to 80% subsidy for setting up Custom Hiring Centres (CHC).
how_to_apply: Apply online at agrimachinery.nic.in

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
eligibility: All farmers, traders, and Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs)
benefits: Transparent price discovery through competitive online bidding, direct payment to bank account, reduced transaction costs and middleman fees.
how_to_apply: Register as farmer on enam.gov.in or visit local e-NAM enabled APMC mandi

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), FPOs, Agri-entrepreneurs, Startups, Farmers
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention on loans up to ₹2 crore for up to 7 years + Credit Guarantee coverage under CGTMSE for loans up to ₹2 crore.
how_to_apply: Apply online at agriinfra.dac.gov.in

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
description: Holistic growth of horticulture sector covering fruits, vegetables, root & tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, flowers, aromatic plants, cashew & cocoa.
eligibility: Horticulture farmers, SHGs, FPOs, Cooperatives
benefits: Subsidies ranging from 35% to 50% for polyhouses, shade net houses, drip/sprinkler irrigation, drip installation, cold chains, and planting material.
how_to_apply: Apply through District Horticulture Officer or midh.gov.in

name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) – Fisheries
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Scheme to bring about Blue Revolution through sustainable development of fisheries sector.
eligibility: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fish vendors, SC/ST/women, FPOs, Entrepreneurs
benefits: Financial assistance / subsidy of 40% for General category and 60% for SC/ST/Women for fish ponds, biofloc units, cages, fish feed mills, and refrigerated vehicles.
how_to_apply: Apply through District Fisheries Office or pmmsy.dof.gov.in

name: National Livestock Mission (NLM) – Dairy & Poultry
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Capital subsidy for breed improvement and entrepreneurship development in poultry, sheep, goat, piggery, and fodder sectors.
eligibility: Individuals, FPOs, SHGs, JLGs, Section 8 companies
benefits: 50% capital subsidy up to ₹50 lakh for poultry, sheep/goat breeding farms, piggery, and feed/fodder manufacturing units.
how_to_apply: Apply online at nlm.udyamimitra.in

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
description: Financial, technical, and business support for micro food processing units (pickle, flour mill, spice grinding, oil extraction, fruit processing).
eligibility: Existing micro food processing enterprises, SHGs, Producer Cooperatives, FPOs
benefits: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to ₹10 lakh per unit. Seed capital of ₹40,000 per SHG member for working capital and small tools.
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmfme.mofpi.gov.in

name: Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation Scheme)
description: Promotes micro-irrigation technologies (drip and sprinkler irrigation) to maximize water use efficiency in farm fields.
eligibility: All categories of farmers having cultivable land and water source
benefits: 55% subsidy for Small & Marginal farmers and 45% for Other farmers for installing Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems.
how_to_apply: Apply through State Agriculture / Horticulture department portal or nearest officer

name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 FPOs Scheme
description: Formation and handholding of 10,000 new Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs) to leverage economies of scale in purchasing inputs and marketing produce.
eligibility: Minimum 300 farmers in plains / 100 farmers in North-East & Hilly regions forming a registered FPO
benefits: Matching equity grant up to ₹15 lakh per FPO + Management cost support up to ₹18 lakh over 3 years + Credit Guarantee facility up to ₹2 crore.
documents: List of member farmers with Aadhaar
how_to_apply: Contact implementing agencies (NABARD, SFAC, NCDC) or visit sfacindia.com

name: Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material (SMSP)
description: Ensures availability of high-quality certified seeds of high-yielding varieties to farmers at subsidized rates through Seed Village Programme.
eligibility: All farmers, with focus on small/marginal and SC/ST farmers
benefits: 50% assistance on foundation/certified seeds distribution under Seed Village Programme + training on seed production.
how_to_apply: Contact local Agriculture Extension Officer or Gram Panchayat

name: Har Med Par Ped (Sub-Mission on Agroforestry)
description: Encourages tree plantation on farm bunds and boundaries along with agricultural crops to generate additional income.
eligibility: Farmers holding agricultural land willing to plant trees on bunds/field boundaries
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹70 per plant (up to ₹28,000/ha) over 4 years for survival rate maintenance.
how_to_apply: Contact District Forest / Agriculture Department

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAFTAAR)
description: Promotes agri-entrepreneurship and agri-startups through financial support and incubation for innovative farming ideas.
eligibility: Agri-startups, young innovators, agricultural graduates, farmers with innovative business ideas
benefits: Grant-in-aid up to ₹5 lakh (idea/pre-seed stage) and up to ₹25 lakh (seed stage startup) for commercialisation of agri-tech solutions.
how_to_apply: Apply through RKVY-RAFTAAR Agribusiness Incubator (RABI) centers at major SAUs and ICAR institutes

name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) Advisory & Training
description: District-level agricultural science centers providing vocational training, front-line demonstrations, and real-time weather & crop advisory.
eligibility: All farmers, farm women, and rural youth in the district
benefits: Free technical guidance, crop disease diagnosis, soil testing, seasonal crop advisory (mKisan SMS), and vocational skill training.
documents: Mobile number for mKisan SMS registration
how_to_apply: Visit nearest KVK in your district or register on mkisan.gov.in for mobile advisories

name: National Bamboo Mission (NBM)
description: Promotes complete bamboo value chain from planting high-yielding bamboo varieties to setting up processing units and crafts.
eligibility: Farmers, Panchayats, SHGs, Artisans, Entrepreneurs
benefits: 50% subsidy up to ₹1.20 lakh/ha for bamboo plantation + up to 50% subsidy for setting up bamboo processing and handicraft units.
how_to_apply: Apply through State Bamboo Mission or nbm.nic.in
